rules.rule: Every KK, KK-KOMBO, mK, and sK is an exact excerpt copied directly from one of the 324 original FullMix LT-PIX SSOTs, with exact source identity and hash lineage.
INSTRO-ONLY / INO-PIX material is separate inventory and is forbidden as a source for any KUT, K-KUT buyer flow, HUG customer selection, or II delivery path.
Establish and lock the complete sequential BLK map first. Only then may KKr CC an exact KK from one proven BLK or an exact KK-KOMBO across source-contiguous proven BLKs.

Verify the CC against the original FullMix, including complete vocal onset, last vocal note, musical resolution, and no adjoining-BLK trespass. Only after that verification may a permitted KK/KOMBO heading be added.
A heading is post-capture KK/KOMBO metadata. It never establishes a BLK, moves a boundary, creates a CC, or changes captured audio.
For KLEIGH works, a proven recurring chorus/title passage may display as Refrain or Refrain[n]. Every other section remains BLK[n]; guessed verse, chorus, and bridge labels are forbidden.

Duration never triggers, generates, qualifies, disqualifies, or approves a KK, KK-KOMBO, mK, or sK. Time is locator and verification metadata only. The separate SWSP instrumental product rule requires at least 13 seconds and does not apply to these KUT tiers.
Holiday LT-PIX is forbidden when directly used for that same specific holiday buyer path.
Music Maykers, LT-PIX, internal source labels, and internal inventory names must not display on public UI.
Do not create the same II twice unless ADMIN explicitly directs it.
mKs / mini-KUTs are forbidden in public buyer flow unless ADMIN override is active.
